summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a November 3, 2026 press release and corporate presentation tied to its Capital Markets Day, highlighting the izicopan development path in ANCA-associated vasculitis. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. The disclosure covers plans to begin two Phase 2 trials in 2027 with first data anticipated in 2028, plus formation of an AAV and renal disease Advisory Board. This is ordinary clinical and business updating, not a special situation; watch trial initiation timing and any future financing needs.
